questions.question: On this day in 1947, Princess Elizabeth married Lieutenant Philip Mountbatten, who was created the Duke of which city?
questions.explanation: Upon marrying the future Queen Elizabeth II in November 1947, Philip Mountbatten received the title Duke of Edinburgh.
questions.context:
On this day in 1947: Princess Elizabeth, daughter of King George VI, married Lieutenant Philip Mountbatten, who was given the title Duke of Edinburgh.
Elizabeth II (Queen of the United Kingdom from 1952 to 2022): Elizabeth II was Queen of the United Kingdom and other Commonwealth realms from 6 February 1952 until her death in 2022. She was queen regnant of 32 sovereign states during her lifetime and was the monarch of 15 realms at her death.

questions.question: Which ancient author's classic Hindu epic provides the source material for Nitesh Tiwari's 2026 mythological film Ramayana: Part 1?
questions.explanation: Ramayana: Part 1 is an adaptation based on the epic poem attributed to the ancient poet Valmiki.
questions.context: Ramayana: Part 1 (2026 Indian film by Nitesh Tiwari): Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first instalment of a two-part film series, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana, which chronicle the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile.

questions.question: Leigh Nash achieved international recognition in the late 1990s as the lead singer of which American band?
questions.explanation: Leigh Nash is the frontwoman and vocalist of the alternative rock band Sixpence None the Richer.
questions.context: Leigh Nash (American singer (born 1976)): Leigh Anne Nash is an American singer and songwriter. She is best known as the lead vocalist of the Christian alternative rock band Sixpence None the Richer, and was also a member of the musical collective Fauxliage. Her debut solo album, Blue on Blue, was released in August 2006, followed by two additional solo albums in 2011 and 2015. Nash has received two Grammy Award nominations: Best Rock Gospel Album in 1998 and Best Pop Performance by a Duo or Group with Vocal in 1999.

questions.question: Which artificial intelligence company was set up in 2021 by siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei after leaving OpenAI?
questions.explanation: The Amodei siblings co-founded Anthropic, the creators of the Claude family of language models, in 2021.
questions.context: Anthropic (American artificial intelligence company): Anthropic, PBC is an American artificial intelligence (AI) public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its flagship product is Claude, a series of proprietary large language models (LLMs). In January 2021, Anthropic was founded by former members of OpenAI over disagreements on AI safety, including siblings Daniela Amodei and Dario Amodei, who are president and CEO, respectively.

questions.question: Which Byzantine ruler commanded the construction of the sixth-century Iron Gate dam near Antioch to protect against flooding?
questions.explanation: Emperor Justinian I ordered the construction of the masonry arch dam to control torrential waters from the Parmenios stream.
questions.context: Iron Gate (Antioch) (Dam in Antakya, Turkey): The Iron Gate is a sixth-century dam located in the mountains to the east of Antakya in Turkey. It is one of the earliest known arch dams and is the oldest to survive. It was built in the mid–sixth century on the order of the Byzantine emperor Justinian I to impound and slow the waters of the Parmenios stream, which in the rainy season could cause torrential floods endangering Antioch's city centre.
